name: Margaretha Schrüfer
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 65818037 (Bartholomew Schriefer, Most Holy Redeemer Cemetery, Baltimore)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Frank and Shugars Families" (tree 113007221), citing the Mistendorf parish registers and Baltimore church and civil records
Matricula Online, Archdiocese of Bamberg, Mistendorf (Mariä Himmelfahrt), baptisms 1808–1851 (M5/28), 1839, page 62, entry 3
notes: Mother of Bartholomäus (Bartholomew Schriefer), born 9 Sep 1839 at Zeegendorf in the parish of Mistendorf, near Bamberg: the baptism register names her A. Margaretha Schrüfer, single and Catholic, and leaves the father's name blank (Mistendorf baptism register, 1839, page 62, no. 3).
